segments.description: Coaches, our next presenter is Mike Barrell, founder and CEO of Evolve 9. Mike is a globally recognised leader in junior tennis development, having worked in over 80 countries and authored the ITF Tennis Tens Manual. An Executive Director of Tennis at Sports Science Clubs, Mike drives innovation in programming and staff development. In this session, creating engaging pathways in junior tennis development, he'll explore strategies for building dynamic child-centred programs. Please welcome Mike. Hey, thanks for joining this presentation and thanks very much for everyone at Tennis Australia for inviting me to contribute to this virtual Grand Slam Coaches conference. Just to give you a little bit of background, my name is Mike Barrell. I am the Executive Director of Tennis for Sport Time in New York, which is the home of the John McEnroe Tennis Academy and we're very proud to say the largest indoor club in the world with 29 indoor courts. We have 13 clubs and a staff of over 200 coaches working for us. So a lot of the things that I delve into on a daily basis is trying to help my coaches upscale and trying to create some philosophies in terms of how we go forward. So a little bit of this presentation really is about the concept of play because I was really intrigued by the title of the conference. But it's also about how we look at it and how we try and simplify things so that we
